content: Rahn ehu Naomi ahpw padahkihong Rud, “Nei serepein, e konehng I en rapahkihong uhk omw pwoud, pwe en kak mie omw peneinei.
Tamataman me Pohas, me ke kin ieiang nah lih akan doadoahk, iei emen kisehta. Nna, rong mahs! Nin soutiket ohlo pahn kihkihsang kilin parli kan.
Eri, kamwakeleiukada, kapwohtikla oh likawihada omw likou me keieu kaselel. Kohla wasa me e pahn wie kamwakamwakel ie; ahpw ke dehpa mweidohng en kilanguhkada lao mwurin eh pahn mwenge oh nim wain.
Ni eh pahn wendi pwe en meirla, kilangete wasa me e pahn wendi ie. Kohla oh pahkada ipe tehi nin neh; kowe eri wendi wasao. Ohlo eri pahn padahkihwei dahme ke pahn wia.”
Rud ahpw sapeng, “I pahn wia soahng koaros me ke nda.”
Eri, Rud ahpw kohla wasahn kamwakel parli, oh kapwaiada soahng koaros me Naomi padahkihong.
Ni Pohas eh mwenge oh nim wain, e ahpw nsenamwahula. Ih eri kohla wendi pwe en meir limwahn kapakap en parli ehu. Rud ahpw waila, pahkada ipen Pohas tehi nin neho oh wendi mpe.
Nipwongo Pohas memeir oh ahpw koahnokte, pwuriamweikihla eh diarada me lih emen wonohn limwahn neh kan.
E ahpw idek, “Ihs kowe?” Serepeino sapengki, “Ngehi Rud. Pwehki komwi peneinei keren men, oh kolokol pwukoahn apwahpwalih ie, komw pwoudikiniehda.”

Pohas eri sapeng nda, “KAUN-O en ketin kupwuramwahwihiuk, nei serepein. Omw wiewia mwahu ahnsou wet kasalehda omw kin nsenohki omw peneinei laudsang me ke wiahiong Naomi, inen omw pwoudo; pwehki ke sohte raparapahki mwahnakapw emen, me kepwehpwe de semwehmwe.
Eri, ke dehpa masepwehk nei serepein; aramas koaros wasaht, ese me kowe lih mwahu men. I pahn wia soahng koaros me ke peki.
Mehlel me ngehi peneinei keren men, oh kin pwukoahkin uhk; ahpw mie emen ohl me keren sang ie.

Ke pahn mihmi wasaht pwohnget, nimenseng kita pahn rapahkihda ma ohlo pahn pwukoahkin uhk. Ma iei, eri, mwahu; ma soh, a I kahukihla ni mwaren Koht ieias me ngehi me pahn ale pwukoa wet. Nna, wendi, meirla.”
Eri, Rud ahpw meirla limwahn nehn Pohas akan lel nimenseng. Ahpw e mwesel mwohn aramas ar pahn esehda; pwehki Pohas padahkihong me sohte me pahn ese me e kohla wasao.
Pohas eri ndaiong Rud, “Wahdo omw koaduhpwelen oh perekipeseng.” Pohas ahpw wudekihong loale kereniong paunen parli 100 oh sewese Rud en pwekada. Eri, Rud ahpw kohkolahng nan kahnimwo.
Rud eri pwurala ni imwe oh Naomi idek reh, “Ia iromw, nei serepein?” Rud ahpw koasoiaiong duwen soahng koaros me Pohas wiahiong, oh nda,
“E pil kihong ie uwen parli pwukat, pwehki eh padahkihong ie me I sohte pahn pwurodo rehmw kahiep.”
Naomi ahpw padahkilahng, “Kanengamahiong, nei serepein, lao irair wet pahn soandi; pwehki pein Pohas sohte pahn meleilei rahnwet e lao pahn koasoanehdi ire wet.”
